notes: family: climbing-shedding. Season ends when only one player still holds cards. 12 score tokens in box (4 each of +2/+1/-1) = 4 seasons. 2-player: played until one player wins 3 seasons (per review; the tokens differ) - enter seasonsFirstOut only. No official tiebreak found; shared victory assumed. Fan-written rules PDF confirms token ranking; token values per player count verified via review text, not the official rulebook. Re-checked: official rulebook still not retrievable (oinkgames.com has no PDF link); fan rewrite lets players choose the number of seasons, reviews state 4 seasons for 3+ players.
